title: processkit.toml document-sources
description: The [[document-sources]] array of tables in processkit.toml, shown as its JSON equivalent (PK-DOC-001, PK-DOC-003). Other tables of processkit.toml are owned by other specifications; the file schema is closed (cli@v1 PK-CONFIG-001).

pattern.description: Path pattern relative to the repository root, / as separator. * matches any characters except /; ? matches one character except /; ** as a whole segment matches zero or more segments. No other special characters. Must end in .md.

namespace.description: Container name every matched Document belongs to; root for the root Container.

labels.description: Labels of every matched Document (ontology@v1 label syntax).

summary.description: Summary of every matched Document that does not declare its own.

triggers.description: Triggers of every matched Document that does not declare its own.
